newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung completes construction of car plant.
newsitem.headline: Samsung completes construction of car plant.

text.p: Samsung Motors Inc, a unit of South Korea's Samsung Group, said on Saturday it has completed construction of its Shinho plant in Pusan with a total investment of two trillion won ($2.4 billion).
Samsung Motors said in a statement it had also started the test run of production facilities.
"We completed the construction three months earlier than scheduled. Commercial production could start two or three months earlier than originally planned March 1998," said the statement.
Samsung Motors plans to produce 65,000 vehicles in 1998, with annual output rising to 250,000 in 1999 and 500,000 in 2002.
The Samsung Group won a government licence to build cars in a technical tie-up with Japan's Nissan Motor Co in 1994 to enter South Korea's already crowded automobile industry.
Samsung Motor, set up by the group the following year, began construction of its Shinho plant in April 1995. (Conversion: $1 = 825 won)
